messages:
tess: Pushing lightweight-prefetcher v0.9 to canary (eng-runtime). Small runtime change that prefetches likely KV prefixes only when it increases coalescing efficiency. Early bench looks promising.
omar: numbers?
tess: quick harness (chat-short, seq=48):
```
Benchmark: chat-short (seq=48)
Baseline    p50=11.6ms  p95=46.2ms  cost=0.110 units
LP v0.9     p50=8.7ms   p95=44.0ms  cost=0.092 units  (-16.4% cost)
```
ria: Nice. Any increase in host CPU or network chatter?
tess: CPU +1.8% on canary hosts, negligible network uptick. Effective prefix-hits +2.6pp. No cold-start regression.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for lightweight-prefetcher v0.9 (5% eu-west) :rocket:
sam: Ops note — watch the "prefetcher" and "kv-hitrate" panels; I added a dash link in #oncall: https://console.redwood/perf/lightweight-prefetcher
tess: Rollout plan: 5% -> 30% after 90m -> 75% after 6h -> 100% after 24h if gates clear. Gate: p99 >6% regression OR error-rate >0.4% -> rollback.
omar: runtime-only change? any driver tweaks?
tess: runtime-only. Introduced a lightweight prediction heuristic and thresholded async prefetch. No CUDA/driver changes.
ria: Perf QA ran a jitter test matrix — thumbs up from QA. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: regression-scan complete 30m window 1: no alerts. :white_check_mark:
tess: kicking off per-tenant cost-diff job for first 24h and will drop to #finance. Expect winners to be high-prefix-dup tenants.
sam: small nit — what's the CLI toggle if we need to cut quickly?
tess: quick toggle: `redwood-admin feature toggle lightweight_prefetcher --env canary --off`
tess: thanks all — small change, nice latency + cost win for interactive chat. will update at 90-minute checkpoint. :party:
